verdict.rationale: Orama documents a programmatic API for creating, inserting into, and searching databases, including `insertMultiple`, the Faceted Search API and AnswerSession. Orama Cloud is described as having 'a simple API' with official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs, and an llms.txt index plus an MCP server make the docs agent-consumable. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths 404), an explicit REST endpoint reference for Orama Cloud in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
